name: dispenser
description: Acts-backed dispenser blocks. Public typed verbs queue work, deliver an artifact, or cancel; the anchored block composes concise Acts on its containing room's sequenced log and one bounded $dispenser_queue projection owns pending membership, admission indexes, id allocation, and terminal receipts.

classes.description: A $note produced by a $dispenser_block. Content remains artifact-authoritative; the delivered Act carries only this note reference. Dropping one into a room recycles it after a note_dispersed live observation.

verbs.name: moveto

classes.description: Plug-driven artifact dispenser. order/deliver/cancel are sequenced domain verbs; the block is an anchored Act composer and its containing room is the log authority. Queue state lives only in $dispenser_queue. After genesis the block cannot move to a different log space. Owner limits can lower, never remove, the Net-proven hard caps of 50 pending rows and 200 inline request characters.
